notes.title: Update 0.2: Hazards!
notes.content:
Gameplay

- New Area: Lava Mountains: 

    Has unique features and dangers
    Drone hubs can be placed in the Lava Mountains!

- New Area: Forests

    Forests are similar to mines, with unique sets appearing on each planet
    Exploding Plants
    Hit and it will drop spores and eventually explode! It will take a while to recharge
    Geodes

- New feature:

 	Consumables: These can be used from the menu to restore energy or health. And may have other boosts later on!
	
- New Resources/Items/Recipes:

 	Obsidian, Processed Obsidian, Brown Geode, Black Geode, Laser Cutter, Phantom Quartz, Garnet, Celestine, Sulfur Gas, Condensed Sulfur, Purple Spores, Yellow Spores, Biofuel
 	Consumables: Energy Pack, Health Pack

- New Machine:

 	Laser Cutter: Will be used to open Geodes for now might have more uses later like cutting gems or other materials.

- Other:

 Drone hubs can harvest gas from geysers
 Drone hubs can be placed in the lava area!
 Health and knockout effects
 Camera zoom control
 Hitting colossal ores will now take much more energy
 New orders

Technical

 Bug fixes
 Performance Improvements
 Improved how HUD UI is handled (big performance improvement)
 Polished sensitivity of multiple scrollviews
 New icon in shop to show which items will refresh
 Orders

 New orders for new items
 Order balancing - Orders will scale with game progress, the further you progress the tougher they will be to finish
 Orders will refresh when on the screen now

notes.title: News on Upcoming Update (Hazards 1)
notes.content:
Thanks for the support and positivity thus far! It's been great, another thanks to those who have also purchased the soundtrack, I hope you are enjoying it as I worked very hard on the music alongside the game, getting better as time went on.

The next update will be the Hazards 1 Update. Which introduces damage and you can be knocked out which will for now just cost some credits/money. 

This will be focused on lava and fire! But may include some forest hazards (though this is not final and may come later).

Also the basics of the Forests will be coming as well - it's been empty for too long. 

Another feature that was requested a while ago that is coming is camera zoom. This unfortunately took a while as some systems had to be rewritten, as they spawned icons based on camera size and when changing the zoom it could spawn icons off the UI. With the update it will handle camera sizes better.


Some screenshots of the lava area (Work in progress)

So there will be lava blocks that can cause damage and you can temporarily put out with water to walk over safely. Also totems that spray fire. Obsidian is a new mineable resource that is being introduced. And more to come!

notes.title: Small Update 0.131
notes.content:
Another small patch

Fixed issue with rice and corn sometimes not appearing
(This still needs improvement, rice will appear after unlocking but only on new seeds/planets, this will be changed - reasons for this kinda thing was initially to 
give players a reason to start new planets but we're starting to change our mind on that, it seems people prefer sticking with a main world and using others as a sort of extra. 
So that's our first BIG gamestyle change based on feedback - we will be allowing players to have a bit more freedom and feel less locked into game decisions)

Another issue we are thinking about is customization. Part of the game theme was that you get these people/operatives/astronauts that you have to work with (with their pros and cons), pick the best of them for the task/your playstyle with minimal customization. 
Kinda mirroring the real world. We don't just get to customize those we work with or befriend haha, but we can help and guide them to grow and improve and that's why there are upgrades and stats (we are still planning on adding a localized upgrade system)
 - but people want customization too badly, so we will be thinking about this further down the line!
 
Technical:
- Fixed crop sorting, sometimes player body could appear through crops
- Fixed issue with rice and corn sometimes not appearing
- Other small bug fixes

Gameplay:
- Nothing this time

Reported issues:
- We had a reported issue of crop specific missions being completed by any crop, this needs a bit more investigation, have not yet reproduced it.
 (If anyone who experiences this as well can provide images, video or info about this in the forums that would be very helpful)


Thank you and keep providing feedback, it's been really helpful so far!

notes.title: Update: Small Update 0.13
notes.content:

We added the crash reporting which is opt in. It would help a lot if you could accept it but we understand those who won't be comfortable with it.

We continue to work on the Hazards update which will bring lava and better implement the health system.

Technical:
- General fixes and improvements
- Cleanup labels, text, descriptions
- Added Unity cloud diagnostics Crash Reporting (opt in or out) (Really makes it a lot easier to debug and gather info on errors without annoying players by asking them too many questions)
- Improved tutorial explanations
- Machines and placeable objects will now be returned to inventory when deleting
- Fixed machine ui panel labels
- Improved atmospheric environmental audio (sea, river, wind, etc)

Gameplay:
- Added Items and Recipes: Sandstone, Glass, Lens, Solar Cells
- The start of resources on the beach (Sandstone will spawn now)
- We've started adding the Lava area (This will bring the first hazards which cause damage) so you might see some parts of it but it's WIP, you won't be able to access it yet

notes.title: Update! Release Date!
notes.content:
The Early Access release date is 24 March 2025! 

It has taken a long time to get here, but we keep pushing forward. Since it is Early Access there is still a lot to come, a lot to fix, a lot of feedback to listen to! We will mostly be using Steam Forums and email for communication.

Right now there are a good amount of missions, upgrades and features in the game. However a current issue is that there is a lack of lore/story connection, we hope those who decide to jump in still find enjoyment and wonder in completing missions and exploring, but this means it will feel very lacking in weight - we promise to work on that. And we hope you will have good feedback for us to improve!

Just a simple update so you know the game is progressing. We are moving closer to a good stable state with a healthy amount of content for EA release!

Lots of new and polished things, but I'm just going to focus on a few here.

This will be the idle seeds: Seeds can be placed into an idle state. Then depending on the goals achieved and resources produced with them, they will then keep producing resources. Better, smarter and harder you work on them and cultivate them, the more resources they produce. Balancing this is going to be one of the hardest tasks! lol). You cannot access them again once put into this state. Only delete, replace or put on pause. There will be stats to upgrade affecting them, maybe even modifiers later on. Lots of upgrades:

Shop and order system (Orders as in requests for specific items, this gives you great rewards):

This shows your lab and galaxy scanner (names not final!). These are like idle missions of an expanding scanner system where you can use drones/bots to clear the way and discover more and also mine resources:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38223288/086ab87a62f6d0b5a94483df9eb6f592e2b44d4b.png


A lot more has changed and been improved, but that's all I want to show for now. There is a healthy amount of systems and mechanics now. I am polishing and building them up more everyday. It's basically the end of a phase of adding the new features for Early Access release and that's definitely a milestone. The other new features will be saved for after EA and will be shown later on a roadmap. (Things like weather control, time machine, more kinds of drones or drone advancements, etc)

Thank you all for being patient so far. The game is progressing, no solid dates yet. It's been tough at times but the game is coming! 

Thank you and see you soon!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
As you may have noticed the release period has been changed from 2023 to "To Be Announced". 
Due to some personal developments, it was decided that it would not be best to keep the current release schedule and delay it for now.


We know that this may be disappointing to many, but us not being able to fully dedicate our efforts to the production during the Early Access phase would have been a disaster.
